title: [Feature]: 应用程序协议新增客户端预设配置备份管理
body:
目前最不明确的就是【应用程序】这个模块，它集成了超级命令、预处理命令、特殊操作等功能，同时又可以扫描游戏库目录。

当前这两个混合在一起，显得比较臃肿，因此很多功能都是下放到了配套的客户端【Moonlight V+ & VoidLink & MacOS Enanced】来实现，而不是开发到【应用程序】。比如调整屏幕组合，指定显示器，修改码率等。

有个矛盾点是，增加大量功能在【应用程序】会显得臃肿，很多配置用户自己改了，然后不知道又到处问。如果应用程序变多，那肯定会比较地狱。

但是如果是在客户端添加，用户又会嫌麻烦，每个客户端都要修改一遍。

还有种场景，V+的用户中，有人修改了【屏幕组合】，却忘记了，导致一直是副屏串流，于是我们又很贴心的添加了新提示。

如此反复，我认为应当添加一个模板配置，用于给客户端使用的，客户端可以在sunshine上创建几个预设的方案，类似云备份。客户端可以自己切换需要的方案，而这个方案在sunshine上面是不生效，避免有多个配置入口。

title: Proposal: negotiated host-restart intent for console-session migration
body:
# Proposal: negotiated host-restart intent for console-session migration

**Allocation-review proposal.** Prepared 2026-10-31 for qiin2333 and AlkaidLab maintainers. Posting is limited to these two repositories; moonlight-stream and LizardByte remain a later phase pending allocation-review feedback. A reference implementation is in progress locally; no new protocol implementation is published in a public branch yet. Nothing in the new protocol has run live.

## Issue-ready summary

SunshineService must respawn Core when the active Windows console session changes, including RDP-to-console handoffs. Today that orderly migration uses the same shutdown path as a real service stop. Remaining peers are sent termination type `0x0109` with reason `0x80030023`. After video has been received, common-c maps this to `ML_ERROR_GRACEFUL_TERMINATION`; the investigated Moonlight client deliberately excludes that result from automatic reconnect. The user must reconnect manually even though the service intends to restart Core.

This mechanism is supported by source inspection and public maintainer discussion in [LizardByte/Sunshine#964][prior-art]. Retained logs support the surrounding session/shutdown behavior, but do not establish a timestamp-correlated reproduction of the reported incident or prove receipt of its final packet. No new protocol behavior has been validated live.

We propose a new reason in the existing four-byte termination payload, enabled only by bidirectional versioned negotiation, encrypted control, and explicit application opt-in. Genuine stops and legacy peers keep the existing graceful reason. A private service-to-Core bridge carries migration intent before shutdown; the client maps the negotiated reason to a distinct library result and uses bounded, authenticated recovery. A fresh launch of the original commandless Desktop app is sufficient after Core loses its active-app state; this does not preserve managed games or bypass Windows sign-in.

**Allocation requests, all provisional pending maintainer review:** reason `SS_TERMINATION_HOST_RESTART_V1 = 0x53535201`; host `LI_FF_HOST_RESTART` / `host_restart = 0x00000800`; client `ML_FF_HOST_RESTART = 0x00000100`; `ML_ERROR_HOST_RESTART = -5502`; SDP attributes `x-ss-restart.protocolVersion` and `x-ml-restart.protocolVersion`, both decimal `1`.

Land common-c support and application handling first; enable host emission last. Test exact wire bytes, negotiation, mixed peers, stop/restart races, refreshed launch/resume selection, cancellation, and a shared hard recovery deadline before separately authorized live testing.

The guarantee is deliberately limited to **delivered intent**. A received genuine graceful-stop result remains terminal; a lost final packet can still enter existing transport-loss recovery. Reconnecting on every graceful exit would incorrectly revive deliberate stops. We seek agreement on allocations, semantics, application API, rollout, and test coverage.

---

## Full proposal

### 1. Problem, evidence, and scope

The service launches Core in the active physical-console session. When that session ID changes, it terminates the old Core and launches another in the new session. Keeping the old process alive would not migrate its capture/input context into the new Windows session. Upstream [commit `9955890023e4f855231d1690555c7ffda7264cdf`][respawn-commit] introduced this behavior; the [maintainer explanation in issue #964][prior-art] explicitly describes temporary disconnection when returning from RDP to the console.

The investigated host baseline is [Foundation `bcbb5ec76afc27964b04142eeded465bf61d6a49`][host-base], with deployed-fork source [ `7f4e2c7bea02827a65c26d2d4263333f39ec9349`][host-fork]. The investigation found the same service/process shutdown plumbing in those revisions. `RunTerminationHelper()` attaches to Core's console and sends Ctrl-C; Core's SIGINT handler raises `mail::shutdown`. No migration reason crosses that boundary. The control thread builds the existing termination packet with `0x80030023`, sends it reliably through the negotiated control encoding, and flushes ENet.

The investigated client baseline is [Qt `081c744d36bd03a74dc70e283251251331cde9b2`][qt-baseline], using actual common-c integration revision [`ad892b7c70185809027995227385b1a63523536d`][client-library-baseline], not simply qiin's `master`. The library maps `0x80030023` to `ML_ERROR_GRACEFUL_TERMINATION` after a received frame, or `ML_ERROR_UNEXPECTED_EARLY_TERMINATION` before one. The client deliberately excludes the graceful result from retry. This proposal does not assert that every Qt/vplus version already has the same retry worker.

**Evidence boundaries:** source inspection establishes the mechanism. Retained Core/Windows logs support session transitions, requested shutdowns, and a separate same-process lock/unlock recovery; some recorded client disconnects preceded Core shutdown. Those logs do not prove the exact reported active-stream handoff, the initiating service reason, or client receipt of the final packet. There was no packet capture of that incident. The final investigation conclusion is a joint host/client gap: the host needs distinct intent, and the client needs restart-aware handling plus fresh host state. Neither a capture-only fix nor a client state-refresh fix alone covers a delivered orderly-migration termination.

Core respawn also loses process-local active-app and launch-ticket state. `/serverinfo` can report a free host, while `/resume` rejects with `NO_APP_TO_RESUME`. Existing pairing permits a new authenticated `/launch`. The first target is recovery of the original **commandless Desktop** app. Graceful cleanup may terminate a managed game's process group and run undo commands; preserving that game is outside v1.

There is no credential storage, login bypass, RDP takeover, automatic session switching, Desktop substitution, persistent transport redesign, or app-lifecycle persistence in this proposal.

### 2. Explicit allocation requests and wire format

**Please approve or replace every proposed allocation below before treating it as interoperable. These are not reserved assignments. All new numbers are provisional pending review; existing protocol constants are unchanged.**

| Namespace | Proposed allocation | Requested value / use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Termination reason | `SS_TERMINATION_HOST_RESTART_V1` | `0x53535201`, host-to-client migration intent |
| Host feature mask | `LI_FF_HOST_RESTART`, host mirror `host_restart` | `0x00000800` in `x-ss-general.featureFlags` |
| Client feature mask | `ML_FF_HOST_RESTART` | `0x00000100` in `x-ml-general.featureFlags` |
| Library termination result | `ML_ERROR_HOST_RESTART` | `-5502`, common-c-to-application notification |
| Host SDP attribute | `x-ss-restart.protocolVersion` | Decimal `1` in DESCRIBE |
| Client SDP attribute | `x-ml-restart.protocolVersion` | Decimal `1` in ANNOUNCE |

Keep the existing termination control type `0x0109`, header layout, and payload-length conventions. The payload remains **exactly one four-byte big-endian uint32**:

```text
Proposed migration reason: 0x53535201 -> 53 53 52 01
Existing graceful reason: 0x80030023 -> 80 03 00 23
```

`53 53 52 01` identifies SSR/version 1. Do not append flags, strings, or a second message. Existing negotiated control encryption wraps the packet as usual.

Host and client feature masks are different namespaces. A host allocation such as `LI_FF_CLIENT_RESOLUTION_CHANGE = 0x400` is not a client allocation. Client `0x80` is already used by `ML_FF_DS5_HAPTICS_IR_EXTENDED` in the relevant fork line, so it is not proposed here. `-5502` is a requested extension value, not a claim to the next upstream `ML_ERROR_*` integer; it is distinct from the existing API-return `LI_ERR_UNSUPPORTED = -5501`.

### 3. Negotiation and application opt-in

1. A capable host advertises the host bit plus `x-ss-restart.protocolVersion:1` only when its service/Core bridge is supported. Portable Core without that bridge must not advertise v1.
2. common-c exposes a provisional `LiSetHostRestartRecoveryEnabled(bool)` API, default **false**, set only before `LiStartConnection()`, with no mid-connection change. This avoids changing `STREAM_CONFIGURATION` or callback-structure layouts.
3. An application opts in only when restart-aware recovery is installed and automatic reconnect is enabled for that Session. Merely upgrading common-c must not opt an unaware application in.
4. common-c advertises the client bit and `x-ml-restart.protocolVersion:1` only to Sunshine, after matching host support/version, with application opt-in and encrypted control negotiated.
5. Both endpoints latch acceptance **per stream connection**. v1 requires both bits, matching version `1`, and encrypted control. Missing/malformed attributes or unknown/incompatible versions mean no acceptance; parse failures receive explicit repository-standard diagnostics.
6. A received restart reason without valid negotiation is a **terminal protocol error**, never a generic unknown error that the application happens to retry. New connections reset negotiation state; prior host support or application opt-in must not leak into unrelated connections.

Capability discovery is not authentication. Existing paired/TLS launch and control protection remain required and unchanged.

### 4. Service-to-Core bridge and shutdown ordering

Use two private, unnamed, manually reset Windows event handles: a fresh `restart_event` for each Core generation and an inheritable duplicate of the service's terminal `stop_event`. Pass only the required handle rights through `PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST` and a private service launch contract, provisionally:

```text
--service-control-version=1 --service-restart-event=<handle> --service-stop-event=<handle>
```

These are not global named objects, HTTP endpoints, credentials, or user prep commands. Core accepts the contract only for service launch under SYSTEM, validates version/handles explicitly, and starts its waiter before network services. Invalid bridge startup is a logged failure, not silent advertised support. Service and Core must be a matched pair; mixed generations do not advertise v1. Keep handles valid until that Core exits and never reuse its restart event for another generation.

| Event | Required behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Console notification, unchanged ID | Keep Core; no restart intent |
| Temporarily unattached console, `0xFFFFFFFF` | Requery until a stable valid ID; terminal stop still wins |
| Different valid ID, no service stop | Set this generation's restart event; choose `console_session_migration` |
| SERVICE_STOP / PRESHUTDOWN | Set terminal stop event; choose `terminal_stop` |
| User quit, ordinary SIGINT/SIGTERM, ordinary app exit | Preserve terminal behavior; do not manufacture migration intent |
| Hung shutdown, helper failure, watchdog/forced kill | Preserve bounded fallback; no final-packet guarantee |

Outside signal-handler context, publish synchronized shutdown intent **before** raising `mail::shutdown`. Default to terminal. Ordinary signal plumbing must not accidentally erase selected migration intent; explicit terminal stop observed before wire publication overrides it. Recheck the terminal event immediately before selecting the outgoing reason. A terminal stop after restart delivery cannot retract the earlier intent.

For matched pairs, migration uses the event, not overloaded Ctrl-C. Keep the existing Ctrl-C helper as a terminal compatibility/recovery route and retain bounded force-kill fallback. The service cannot safely forge a final control packet after killing Core because it lacks the per-client transport/crypto state.

### 5. Per-session emission and client recovery

Choose the termination reason **inside the host's per-session loop**, not once outside it. Terminal intent always sends `0x80030023`. Migration sends `0x53535201` only to that session's accepted encrypted v1 connection; every other peer receives `0x80030023`. Ordinary app termination and generic Core exit are not restart events.

common-c maps a valid negotiated encrypted restart packet to `ML_ERROR_HOST_RESTART` and delivers connection termination once. Explicit restart is meaningful before or after the first frame; unlike legacy graceful mapping, it does not depend on `lastSeenFrame`. The library reports intent; it does not reconnect.

The application admits that result to recovery without enabling recovery for graceful termination, protected content, frame conversion errors, or user exit. Bypassing the usual received-video gate is allowed only for an authenticated launched Session with known original app identity and application opt-in. A decoder self-test or bare connection attempt is insufficient.

Reuse the separately developing authenticated host-state refresh/different-app guard rather than creating a parallel recovery path:

| Fresh authenticated host state | Retry choice |
| --- | --- |
| Original app still active | `/resume` |
| Host free; original configured app exists | Fresh `/launch` of that original app with new session credentials |
| Different app active | Controlled failure; no takeover |
| Original app unavailable | Explicit failure; no implicit Desktop fallback |

Preserve host/app identity, selected parameters, and the window. Use backoff of 1/2/4/8 seconds, capped at 8, within **one 60-second monotonic outage deadline**. Pre-video restart, post-video restart, repeated restart notices, and connections that die before recovery video all share the same budget. `LiStartConnection()` success alone is not recovery: the first actual recovered host-video frame ends the outage.

Every DNS/HTTP/TLS/launch/resume/RTSP operation must fit the remaining deadline or be cancelled. The investigated `startApp()` uses a 120-second default timeout for both verbs; hard-deadline enforcement is a separate client prerequisite, not something assumed to be included in the state-refresh change. The service's roughly 3-second relaunch delay and possible cleanup/helper waits motivate the draft budget, but **60 seconds is not a measured readiness guarantee**. The 60-second budget and 250-ms drain below are provisional policy/timing proposals, not wire allocations.

Close/Esc/cancel stops recovery immediately. Expiry reports recovery failure rather than retrying app commands indefinitely. No old socket, session crypto, app PID, or Windows credential is carried across Core instances.

### 6. Compatibility matrix

Here, "legacy client" also includes an unaware application linked to new common-c with default opt-in false. The orderly-stop column describes a **received graceful result in an established stream**, not every possible loss or early-start case.

| Host | Client / negotiation | Console migration | Genuine orderly stop |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Legacy | Legacy | Existing graceful disconnect; manual reconnection | Existing terminal behavior |
| Legacy | New; no host bit/version | Existing behavior; do not infer intent from disappearance | Graceful remains terminal |
| New | Legacy; no acceptance | Existing graceful reason | Graceful remains terminal |
| New | New; reconnect disabled or app opt-in false | Existing graceful reason; manual recovery | Graceful remains terminal |
| New | New; both bits/version, opt-in, encrypted control | Explicit restart; bounded refreshed recovery | Existing graceful reason; terminal |
| New | New; no encrypted control | No v1 acceptance; existing behavior | Graceful remains terminal |
| New | New; missing/malformed/incompatible version | No v1 acceptance; existing behavior | Existing behavior |
| Either | Either; force-kill or final packet lost | Existing transport-loss policy; no synthetic restart intent | Cannot infer stop intent from silence |

Legacy `0x80030023` **before the first frame** keeps its existing `ML_ERROR_UNEXPECTED_EARLY_TERMINATION` mapping and existing application eligibility rules. This proposal does not silently redefine that behavior or generic-loss recovery. An unnegotiated new restart reason is instead explicitly rejected as terminal.

### 7. Delivery reliability and why not retry every graceful exit

Reliable ENet send plus flush does not prove receipt if Core exits immediately. A proposed best-effort improvement is to service ENet receive/ACK/retransmission progress on the owning control thread for at most **250 ms** after the final flush, before releasing peers/socket/context. Do not invoke normal input callbacks or mutate session ownership during teardown. Existing shutdown/watchdog bounds, including the relevant 10/20-second bounds, remain authoritative.

Test actual ENet progress and lifetime ordering: sleeping for 250 ms is not a drain. If safe progress cannot be established, retain best-effort flush and document that limitation. Log intent, negotiation, peer availability/send outcome, drain outcome, and forced fallback without keys or client identifiers. This adds no application-level ACK and cannot promise final-message delivery under loss.

The guarantee is **received intent only**: a received genuine graceful-stop result does not trigger reconnect. If that packet is lost, a crash, network outage, and real stop may look identical; existing generic retry may still run. A stop racing after delivered restart cannot retract it either. Absolute "real stops never cause any reconnect attempt" under loss is not provided.

A stronger guarantee requires an authenticated, generation-bound recovery authorization/tombstone owned by the surviving service, or disabling generic-loss recovery. That entails persistence, expiry, and service-availability semantics outside v1; it is not hidden in a feature bit.

Reconnecting on every graceful exit would incorrectly relaunch after deliberate stops and app exits. A permanent capability bit says the host understands signaling, not that this specific shutdown is a restart. Keeping `0x80030023` and adding a separate flag/message would introduce payload or ordering ambiguity. A distinct negotiated reason communicates per-event intent without changing the existing payload layout.

### 8. Public allocation check and its limits

Read-only checks on 2026-10-31 resolved each requested repository's `master` with `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/master`, then read commit-pinned files using `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/contents/<path>?ref=<sha>` with raw-content output. Source text was searched for feature declarations, termination mappings, `ML_ERROR_*`, `LI_ERR_UNSUPPORTED`, and the proposed names/values. These were source checks, not builds or runtime tests.

| Repository | Checked `master` revision | Relevant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| qiin2333/moonlight-common-c | [`41cedb89d6b8592f99c09975c764ca3875034726`][qiin-master] | Inspected host/client declarations use `0x01` and `0x02`; proposed allocations not found in their respective inspected namespaces |
| moonlight-stream/moonlight-common-c | [`5d3c0ecca00c1bb3f587acb8060476edcf8e24aa`][common-master] | Same basic feature allocations; public result definitions include `0`, `-100` through `-104`, and API-return `-5501`, not proposed `-5502` |
| AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine | [`204a96826606b3a34cf2cd813aed0f0a9bba7db0`][foundation-master] | Host capability definitions include reserved `dynamic_sdr_white = 0x100` and `remote_text_context = 0x200`; no host `0x800`; shutdown still builds `0x80030023` |
| LizardByte/Sunshine | [`68f637a261abb2dd2f215e732d29a7de16de732a`][sunshine-master] | Host capability definitions use `0x01` and `0x02`; shutdown still builds `0x80030023` |

For both common-c masters, inspected files were `src/Limelight.h`, `src/Limelight-internal.h`, `src/ControlStream.c`, `src/SdpGenerator.c`, and `src/RtspConnection.c`. For both hosts, inspected file

title: [Bug]: 双显卡笔记本合盖串流后断开，无头主机检测跳过销毁 VDD，开盖后内屏不再亮
body:
### 🏷️ 问题类型

🖥️ 虚拟显示器问题

### 📝 问题描述

双显卡笔记本（内屏接核显）合着盖子串流、合着盖子断开后，内屏再也不会亮：开盖后 Windows 仍然只有 Zako 虚拟屏是激活的，内屏保持关闭，必须手动改拓扑（Win+P 扩展 / `SetDisplayConfig`）才能恢复。

根因看日志是两步叠加：

1. 合盖时 Windows 把内屏从拓扑里拿掉了（设备仍枚举得到，只是 inactive）。此时开始串流，`vdd_prep` 没拿到 pre-VDD 列表，直接「关闭物理显示器」，目标拓扑只剩 VDD。
2. 串流结束时，**无头主机检测**看到「VDD 是唯一显示设备」就判定为无头主机，**跳过销毁 VDD**，也没有恢复物理显示器。于是 Windows 为「内屏 + Zako」这个显示器组合持久化下来的配置就是「内屏关」。之后开盖，Windows 按这份持久化配置应用，内屏仍然不亮。

无头主机检测把「合盖的笔记本」和「真没有显示器的主机」混在一起了。合盖笔记本的内屏在 `WmiMonitorID` / `QueryDisplayConfig(QDC_ALL_PATHS)` 里依然存在，只是 inactive。

建议（任一）：
- 无头判定只在用户显式开启 `headless_create` 时生效；否则串流结束一律销毁 VDD 并恢复 pre-VDD 拓扑。真无头主机销毁 VDD 也没有损失。
- 或者：判定「无头」时检查是否存在 present-but-inactive 的非 VDD 显示器，有则按普通主机处理。
- 或者：把上一次成功记录的 pre-VDD 设备列表持久化，会话开始拿不到时用上一次的，收尾时按它恢复。

### 🔄 复现步骤

1. 双显卡笔记本（本机 Intel Iris Xe 驱动内屏，RTX 4060 Laptop 无直连输出），`display_device_prep = ensure_only_display`，`output_name = ZakoHDR`，`adapter_name` 指向 NVIDIA。
2. 合上盖子（电源选项里合盖动作为「不操作」），从 Moonlight 连接，正常串流。
3. 盖子保持合着，从 Moonlight 断开 / 结束应用。
4. 打开盖子：内屏黑，`Screen.AllScreens` 只有 `\.\DISPLAY52`（Zako），内屏 inactive。

### 🎯 受影响的游戏/应用

与应用无关（Desktop 也复现）

### 🔁 可复现性

总是发生 (100%)

### 💻 主机操作系统

Windows 11

### 📌 Windows 具体版本

Windows 11 25H2 (26200)

### ☀️ Sunshine 版本

v2026.1031.121458.杂鱼

### 🎨 显卡厂商

NVIDIA

### 🎨 显卡型号及驱动

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU（驱动 32.0.15.9159）+ Intel Iris Xe（32.0.101.6790）；ASUS TUF F15 FX507VV，混合输出模式，内屏由核显驱动。vdd_settings.xml 里 `gpu/friendlyname` 已指到 NVIDIA，串流时采集与 NVENC 都在 4060 上，这部分正常。

### 🔧 视频编码器

NVENC

### 📱 客户端设备

iPhone 15，官方 Moonlight iOS 9.0.2，经 Tailscale 直连

### ⚙️ 是否修改过配置？

是

### 📋 已修改的配置

```
adapter_name = NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU
display_device_prep = ensure_only_display
output_name = ZakoHDR
origin_web_ui_allowed = pc
```

### 📸 截图/视频

_无_

### 📜 日志输出

会话开始（盖子已合上）：

```
[17:26:02.827]: Warning: 未提供pre-VDD设备列表，从当前设备枚举中查找物理显示器
[17:26:02.828]: Info: 应用vdd_prep: 关闭物理显示器
[17:26:02.828]: Info: vdd_prep 目标拓扑: [[{d86063fc-03b1-599d-807d-15afe867547a}]]
[17:26:02.829]: Info: 成功应用vdd_prep设置
```

会话结束（盖子仍合着）：

```
[17:31:10.274]: Info: CLIENT DISCONNECTED
[17:31:10.274]: Info: Stopping streaming session 10 [client_uuid=<uuid>, reason=control_disconnect]
[17:31:12.790]: Info: Cancel request from IP: <client-ip>, Port: 51528
[17:31:12.790]: Info: Global app cancel accepted; stopping all streaming sessions asynchronously
[17:31:12.792]: Info: 非常驻模式，销毁VDD
[17:31:12.792]: Info: 无头主机检测：VDD 是唯一显示设备，跳过销毁
[17:31:12.795]: Info: 正在恢复显示设备设置 (原因: 串流结束)
[17:31:12.837]: Info: 显示设备配置已恢复
```

开盖后内屏仍 inactive；此时 `WmiMonitorID` 能枚举到内屏（B156HAN15.H，Active=True 表示设备在线）和 Zako HDR 两个显示器，但拓扑里只有 Zako。

### 💬 其他补充

临时绕过：串流结束钩子里跑一个脚本，发现「非 VDD 显示器在场但未激活、且没有进行中的会话」就 `SetDisplayConfig(SDC_TOPOLOGY_EXTEND)` 再 `SDC_TOPOLOGY_INTERNAL`，并把内屏设回主屏、断开 VDD。可以稳定恢复，但这应该由 Foundation 的收尾逻辑来做。需要更多日志或在这台机器上验证补丁都可以。

thread.body: 已有能力，自适应一下。有不懂问ai，让ai扫一下仓库
没有正确结束串流导致的，把暂停串流和结束串流搞混了。如果你是小白建议你打开这个功能。

感谢回复。我对照了日志、设计文档和源码，这个场景好像不是「把暂停和结束搞混」，补充三点，麻烦再看一眼：

**1. 日志里走的就是结束链路。** 断开 2 秒后客户端发了 cancel，之后的跳过发生在这条链路里：

```
17:31:10.274  CLIENT DISCONNECTED
17:31:12.790  Cancel request from IP: <client-ip>
17:31:12.790  Global app cancel accepted; stopping all streaming sessions asynchronously
17:31:12.792  非常驻模式，销毁VDD
17:31:12.792  无头主机检测：VDD 是唯一显示设备，跳过销毁
17:31:12.795  正在恢复显示设备设置 (原因: 串流结束)
17:31:12.837  显示设备配置已恢复        ← 实际内屏仍未恢复
```

**2. 「所有客户端断开后结束串流」不会改变这个结果。** `docs/source/stop_on_last_video_session.md` 写明该选项「复用现有 `/cancel` 使用的终止协调器」，也就是上面同一条链路，同样会进到 `src/display_device/session.cpp` 的这段：

```cpp
// 无头主机保护：如果销毁后会变成无头（VDD 是唯一显示设备），跳过销毁
auto devices = display_device::enum_available_devices();
bool only_vdd = (devices.size() == 1 && devices.count(vdd_id));
if (only_vdd || devices.empty()) {
  BOOST_LOG(info) << "无头主机检测：VDD 是唯一显示设备，跳过销毁";
  should_destroy = false;
}
```

笔记本合盖时 Windows 会把内屏从拓扑里拿掉，`enum_available_devices()` 只剩 VDD（日志里 `Available display devices` 也只有 Zako HDR），于是被当成无头主机。VDD 没销毁、内屏没恢复，Windows 为「内屏 + VDD」这个组合持久化的就是「内屏关」，之后开盖也不亮。出门时笔记本都是合着盖的，这个场景会稳定命中。

**3. 一个很小的改法建议。** 这个保护的目的（注释写的是避免真无头主机销毁+重建循环）用已有的 `config::video.vdd_headless_create_enabled` 门控就够了：用户没开「无头模式自动创建」的机器，串流结束一律销毁 VDD 并恢复 pre-VDD 拓扑；开了的才保留。这样不影响真无头主机，也不需要新增配置。

如果需要，我这台机器可以稳定复现，可以帮忙验证补丁。

时间 | 提交 / PR | 改动
-- | -- | --
2026-03-09 | a7f1cfd3（#522） | 首次加入 vdd_headless_create 自动创建基地显示器逻辑
2026-03-16 | 11942f03c（#530，重构新版 VDD 模式） | auto-create 移入“无会话配置”清理路径，也就是现在的 [session.cpp (line 951)]
2026-04-08 | f5203968e（#578，修复切换设备串流 VDD 黑屏） | 引入“VDD 是唯一显示设备，跳过销毁”保护，当时是带配置门槛的
2026-04-12 | 977e3015a（#584，修复 vdd 被意外销毁） | 去掉了配置门槛，保护变为无条件
你是对的，我是错的，因为最近一年的屏幕相关的代码大部分都是我在维护，看来有一个我不知道的逻辑混进来了“#584 去掉了配置门槛，保护变为无条件”。所以我会质疑是你开启了无头模式，是我的问题。
退出时的无头保护，可以检测新屏幕连接。有屏幕连上连上自动关闭vdd就行了

我已与 @ShadowLemoon 讨论沟通。将会新增一个功能【自动检测无头状态】，在无串流的时候，自动管理虚拟显示器的启停。

PR作者的无条件保护虚拟显示器，是为了实现【结束串流后虚拟显示器分辨率不变】，因为无头模式创建的虚拟显示器使用的EDID是默认的（这个是我们实现的【显示器缩放比例跟随设备】功能，需要通过EDID区分）。

title: [Bug]: 串流应用页顶栏按钮 hover 时，搜索框/视图切换/应用卡同样闪出硬边色块
body:
### 📝 问题描述

接 #1210（概览页更新卡 / 顶卡的同类问题）。**串流应用页也有同一处病灶**：鼠标划过顶部那排功能按钮——「还原内置应用」「切换多选」「扫描游戏平台库」「关于环境变量」——页面上的玻璃表面会闪出硬边色块。

和 #1210 是同一个根因，不是新问题：面板（WebView2）里 WebUI 是 iframe 内嵌、背后是面板壁纸；`backdrop-filter` 的缓存会被下层重绘（hover 的 `transform` / `box-shadow`、图标变色）部分失效重采样，表面就闪。这页的玻璃面比概览页还密：

| 表面 | blur | 位置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.view-toggle-group`（网格/列表切换） | 10px | 紧邻上述四个按钮 |
| `.search-input`（搜索框） | 4px | 同一行左侧 |
| `.app-card` / `.app-list-item` | 4px / 10px | 下方应用卡（面积最大） |
| `.batch-action-bar`（多选工具条） | 6px | 开启多选后出现 |
| `.btn-edit` / `.btn-delete`（封面上的圆钮） | 5px | 压在每个应用卡上 |

其中 `.view-toggle-group` 和那几个按钮在同一行，所以 hover 时闪得最明显。

### 🔄 复现步骤

1. Control Panel 打开「串流应用」；
2. 鼠标在顶部功能按钮之间来回移动（还原内置应用 / 切换多选 / 扫描游戏平台库 / 关于环境变量）；
3. 同一行右侧的视图切换、搜索框，以及下方应用卡出现硬边色块闪烁。

### 🎯 受影响的游戏/应用

仅 GUI Web 控制面板的串流应用页，与串流、编码无关。

### 🔁 可复现性

总是发生 (100%)

### 💻 主机操作系统

Windows 11

### ☀️ Sunshine 版本

v2026.1102.14513.杂鱼（master @ d9ccdf1 同版本构建）

### 🎨 显卡厂商

NVIDIA

### 🎨 显卡型号及驱动

RTX 5060 Laptop

### ⚙️ 是否修改过配置？

否，使用默认设置

### 📸 截图/视频

同 #1210，录屏可以后补。

### 💬 其他补充

**和 #1210 的关系**：#1210 修的是概览页（`VersionCard` / `Home` / `ErrorLogs`），那部分已被 #1209 的首页重设计整体覆盖。**串流应用页不在 #1209 的改动范围里**（18 个文件里没有 `styles/apps/*`），所以单独开这条。

**修复方向**：和 #1210 一致——把这页常驻表面的底色从 `backdrop-filter` 换成自持底板。

- `styles/apps/mixins.less` 里 `.glass-effect()` / `.glass-effect-light()` 只包了一层 `backdrop-filter`，是本页多数玻璃面的来源，直接删除；
- `.app-card` / `.app-list-item` / `.empty-state` 原本靠 0.62 alpha + 模糊维持观感，底板抬到 `--ui-surface-strong`；
- `.search-input` / `.view-toggle-group` / `.batch-action-bar` 本身就是 0.88 底，摘掉模糊后观感几乎不变；
- `.btn-edit` / `.btn-delete` 原本是 0.12 alpha 的纯色 + 模糊压在封面图上，去掉模糊后需要把底色与 `--ui-surface-strong` 混色，否则会糊在封面里。

弹窗类覆盖层（扫描选项、扫描结果、删除确认、toast）暂不处理，需要的话另开。

title: [BUG][VDD] 动态分辨率热更新重建 VDD 时采集回退到主屏
body:
## 问题描述

在使用 ZakoVDD 副屏串流时，客户端发起动态分辨率更新。如果新分辨率需要重建 VDD monitor，VDD 在重建期间短暂离开 Windows 显示拓扑。

此时采集线程会把旧 VDD 设备视为不可用，并自动选择默认显示器 `\\.\DISPLAY1`。VDD 重建完成后，采集没有恢复到 VDD。后续分辨率请求会被识别为物理显示器请求，最终导致采集画面变成主屏。

## 复现环境

- Windows
- `capture=vdd`
- ZakoVDD sealed frame channel
- VDD 作为副屏
- 客户端支持动态分辨率更新

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 VDD 串流，例如 `1784x1304`。
2. 客户端请求切换到 `1776x1016`。
3. 该分辨率触发 VDD mode list 更新和 monitor 重建。
4. 等待串流继续后，再请求 `2872x1504` 或 `1912x1568`。
5. 观察采集画面和 Sunshine 日志。

## 实际结果

日志显示：

```text
VDD monitor does not advertise 1776x1016@60; recreating the monitor through IOCTL
Previous active display [\\.\DISPLAY26] is no longer present
Client-specified display [...] not found, using default display
[Display Init] Selected display: \\.\DISPLAY1
Device Description ..., Capture: 3840x2160
```

随后：

```text
使用物理显示器，跳过VDD准备
Failed to set display mode
Dynamic display reconfiguration failed
```

实际采集源已经变成物理主屏，VDD 也可能被后续重配置流程销毁。

另外，即使 `configure_display()` 返回失败，日志仍会打印：

```text
Dynamic stream resolution updated
```

这会让人误以为显示模式和采集目标已经成功更新。

## 预期结果

- VDD 重建期间保持逻辑采集目标为 VDD。
- VDD 暂时不可用时等待其重新出现，不自动切换到物理主屏。
- VDD direct capture 失败时，只允许对同一个 VDD 输出尝试 DDX capture。
- VDD monitor 重建完成后，采集线程自动解析新的设备 ID 和 `DISPLAYn` 并恢复采集。
- 只有显示模式、采集目标和编码配置都成功后，才报告动态分辨率更新成功。
- 显示配置失败时保留旧分辨率和旧采集目标。

## 初步根因

当前采集 reinit 依赖旧的 `capture_ctx.config.display_name`。VDD 重建期间该设备 ID 暂时无法解析，`video.cpp` 会回退到默认显示器。

之后 `active_display` 被更新为 `\\.\DISPLAY1`。`stream.cpp` 的动态分辨率处理又根据 `active_display` 反向推断当前目标，并将 `use_vdd` 设置为 `false`，导致后续更新进入物理显示器路径。

涉及位置：

- `src/video.cpp`
  - VDD 设备暂时消失时回退默认显示器。
  - reinit 后没有根据 VDD 逻辑目标重新恢复采集。
- `src/stream.cpp`
  - 根据 `active_display` 反向推断 VDD/物理显示器。
  - 更新失败后仍提交会话分辨率并打印成功日志。
- `src/display_device/session.cpp`
  - VDD monitor 重建与采集 reinit 没有共享 ready/generation 状态。
- `src/platform/windows/display_base.cpp`
  - VDD direct capture 失败后的 DDX fallback 需要限制在同一个 VDD 输出上。

## 建议方案

1. 保存独立的逻辑采集目标，区分 `physical` 和 `vdd`。
2. VDD 目标使用 friendly name/逻辑别名重新解析当前设备 ID，不依赖旧 GUID。
3. 增加 VDD reconfiguration generation 和 ready 通知。
4. VDD 目标暂时不可用时等待并重试，禁止默认回退到物理主屏。
5. 将动态分辨率更新改为候选配置事务，成功后再提交会话分辨率。
6. 删除通过 `active_display` 反向推断 `use_vdd` 的逻辑。
7. 为失败场景增加明确日志，避免把字段更新当成显示配置成功。

## 验收标准

- VDD monitor 重建期间不会出现 `using default display`。
- 不会出现 VDD 热更新过程中选中 `\\.\DISPLAY1` 的日志。
- VDD 重建完成后能够自动恢复 sealed capture 或同一 VDD 输出的 DDX capture。
- 连续多次动态分辨率更新不会销毁 VDD 或切换到主屏。
- 显示模式应用失败时不会打印 `Dynamic stream resolution updated`。
- 物理显示器串流和手动切屏行为不受影响。
```

title: [Feature]: DS5 sidecar 分发合规改造：精简运行时、预签名驱动与制品校验
body:
## 目标

保留现有 DS5 sidecar 架构，解决发行包中 Microsoft SDK/WDK 工具的再分发授权缺口，并建立可持续的构建、驱动交付和制品检查流程。

建议目标方案：

- **Composite DS5**：继续使用现有受管理的 usbip-win2 后端。
- **HID-only DS5**：优先改为安装构建／发布阶段已生成 catalog 并完成正式签名的完整 UMDF 驱动包。
- **运行时**：只携带经过审阅、具有适用分发许可的文件，不再随包携带 SignTool、Inf2Cat 及其工具依赖，也不在普通用户机器上生成测试证书、制作 catalog 或给驱动签名。

本 issue 记录已核实的制品内容、公开许可依据和工程整改任务。当前结论是**尚未确认到覆盖现有驱动部署用途的工具再分发授权**，不作已经构成侵权、违法或刑事责任的判定；若另有有效授权，应补充为可审计的依据。

## 已核实的制品与源码

核查日期：2026-10-29。源码基线为 Foundation `5e9ba6d`、GUI 子模块 `0c5d2667`、HIDMaestro v1.12.0（`b4d29d9f`）。以下版本是本次实际检查的对象，不泛化为所有历史或未来版本。

| Release | DS5 component | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [v2026.1020.23431.杂鱼](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/tag/v2026.1020.23431.%E6%9D%82%E9%B1%BC)（稳定版） | 1.4.2 | Core 内嵌 SignTool、Inf2Cat 及相关依赖 |
| [v2026.1029.22241.杂鱼](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/tag/v2026.1029.22241.%E6%9D%82%E9%B1%BC)（预发布版） | 1.4.3 | 同上 |

两个 `Sunshine.Ds5Sidecar.x64.zip` 均有 198 个 ZIP 条目，其中 `HIDMaestro.Core.dll` 均有 395 个嵌入资源。实际提取并静态检查到：

- `HIDMaestro.Resources.Inf2Cat.exe`，34,880 bytes，ProductVersion `1.0.0519.24+3dc05997`。
- `HIDMaestro.Native.x64.signtool.exe`，543,144 bytes，ProductVersion `10.0.26100.8249`。
- `HIDMaestro.Native.arm64.signtool.exe`，552,912 bytes，ProductVersion `10.0.26100.8249`。
- 对应的 HardwareWorkflow、Kits.Logger、Microsoft.Windows.Build.* 等工具依赖／manifest。

上述三个 EXE 的资源哈希与已检查的上游 HIDMaestro v1.12.0 发行包一致。检查仅为 ZIP／PE／托管资源静态分析，没有执行这些 EXE。

<details>
<summary>制品与关键资源 SHA-256（供复核）</summary>

| 对象 | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| 1.4.2 sidecar ZIP | `8a9b95c407a69b74f91916d5606bfcd04013c8dc124abc0f6c675743b57935ff` |
| 1.4.3 sidecar ZIP | `60669603a3f692869051b5277d633aef1b22586a498a50cd475e187d9ad3eb33` |
| 1.4.2 Core DLL | `eb64a7c4dcaf3def34d1eb87232677962a2da1bb85a294fbddbc6f1b82e88cc6` |
| 1.4.3 Core DLL | `7b3a7f6aa8d0d6f51b149d72562d1985326f5220b93dda426012ef1f200aa182` |
| Inf2Cat 资源 | `b594728d38b271979367abc8060a971b8e42422738009be126710b1f5dd0fcbc` |
| x64 SignTool 资源 | `e7b517a6a2828af2d1fba3da60ae1e322a95141bfae192622725329630caa2b3` |
| arm64 SignTool 资源 | `a97d9284634d5b8a10765f46a2e7085f23c7ceb4bc29181a956c3aa45d520e23` |

复核应先验证 release asset 的哈希，再解压 ZIP、解析 Core 的 ManifestResource 表并对提取后的资源计算 SHA-256。只查看 ZIP 文件名列表会漏掉 DLL 内嵌的工具。

</details>

源码与制品结果一致：

1. Foundation 已经从固定上游源码构建补丁版 Core，但 [PayloadTool](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/tools/hidmaestro-core-patch/PayloadTool/Program.cs) 会提取全部上游资源，并要求补丁版保留全部原资源且字节一致。仅修改外层 ZIP 打包清单无法去除内嵌工具。
2. 上游 [DriverBuilder.cs](https://github.com/hifihedgehog/HIDMaestro/blob/b4d29d9f4b1b91ced6b4755f095184b66339b8be/sdk/HIDMaestro.Core/Internal/DriverBuilder.cs) 的 `EnsureExtracted()` 包含工具及依赖，`FullDeploy()` 会调用 `SignDrivers()`、`GenerateCatalogs()`；需要改变运行流程，不能只删除两个 EXE。
3. 上游 [hidmaestro.inf](https://github.com/hifihedgehog/HIDMaestro/blob/b4d29d9f4b1b91ced6b4755f095184b66339b8be/driver/hidmaestro.inf) 使用通用 `root\HIDMaestro`，其注释明确该 INF 由多个 profile 共用；[DeviceNodeCreator.cs](https://github.com/hifihedgehog/HIDMaestro/blob/b4d29d9f4b1b91ced6b4755f095184b66339b8be/sdk/HIDMaestro.Core/Internal/DeviceNodeCreator.cs) 使用设备实例属性等机制配置实例。因此，固定完整驱动包在发布阶段签名是值得优先验证的方案，不必假设每个用户都需要现场改 INF、重新签名。

## 许可依据与边界

- **HIDMaestro 的 MIT 许可**允许按其条款使用、修改、分发相应代码，并要求保留通知；它本身不能授予 Microsoft 工具的再分发权。独立进程、单独 ZIP、改变下载地址均不能替代对实际载荷的授权检查。
- **SignTool**：[Microsoft 的驱动安装文档](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/install/installing-a-catalog-file-by-using-signtool)明确区分随安装应用分发与调用用户机器上已按许可安装的工具。另据 [SDK REDIST 的 Windows Packaging Tools 项](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/windows-sdk/redist)，SignTool 等文件的公开例外附带 MSIX／MSIXBundle 打包相关用途及其他条件；该例外不能直接用作本项目驱动 DLL／CAT 签名用途的分发依据。这里不将其概括为“所有场景永远禁止分发”。
- **Inf2Cat 与 WDK 依赖**：已核对 WDK 26100.6584 安装器附带许可及其指向的 [WDK REDIST 清单](https://download.microsoft.com/download/9/8/6/986EDCB5-5B68-4416-9BCB-3942FCE5E7B1/Windows%2010%20SDK%20WDK%20Redist%20List.rtf)，未见 Inf2Cat、上述 HardwareWorkflow／Kits.Logger 工具组件的公开分发授权。该结论限定于已核查材料；额外合同、其他适用授权需要另行提供。安装器版本可从 [Microsoft WDK 下载页](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/other-wdk-downloads)复核。
- **历史说明 #1035**：作者当时核对的是不含 HIDMaestro 二进制的旧 sidecar，并说明未来携带 Core 时应附 MIT 通知。该说明不能替代当前已内嵌 Microsoft 工具的再分发授权。

本 issue 聚焦上述软件载荷的分发和驱动交付，不代表已对 Sony 商标、专利、协议实现或全部依赖完成全面法律审查。

## 实施任务

### 1. 精简 Core 的资源与构建输入

- [ ] 建立精确的运行时资源允许清单，记录路径／资源名、来源版本、SHA-256、许可依据和功能用途；按实际支持的模式、架构选择 profile、驱动及其他资源。
- [ ] 从发行载荷中移除 SignTool、Inf2Cat 和随它们复制的工具依赖／manifest；逐项处理依赖，不能只删 EXE，也不能按文件名含 Microsoft 一刀切。
- [ ] 将 PayloadTool 的“全部上游资源逐字节保留”改为“与经过审阅的资源集合完全一致”；继续保留 API、程序集身份、兼容性契约和保留资源哈希校验。
- [ ] 保留现有设备归属、USB 音频节奏、受管理 USB/IP 和 DualSense 报告时钟补丁及必要回归验证。

主要入口：[Core 项目](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/tools/hidmaestro-core-patch/HIDMaestro.Core.csproj)、[补丁构建脚本](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/scripts/build-hidmaestro-core-patch.ps1)、[PayloadTool](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/tools/hidmaestro-core-patch/PayloadTool/Program.cs)。

### 2. 将 HID-only 驱动制作迁到构建／发布阶段

- [ ] 在满足适用 SDK/WDK 许可的构建环境中生成完整 UMDF 驱动包，包含 INF、CAT、DLL 及该包实际需要的文件，并明确支持的 Windows 版本和架构。
- [ ] 落实适用于该驱动及目标系统的正式可信签名路径，验证 Driver Store 入库、安装、加载与设备绑定。CI 自签名或向用户系统自动导入测试根证书不能作为生产方案的替代。
- [ ] 运行时仅进行完整性／签名验证、安装与绑定；删除制作 catalog、签名、生成测试证书及提取开发工具的依赖。
- [ ] 同步修改 `HMContext` 的后台预热、`DriverBuilder.BuildDir/EnsureExtracted()`、已安装驱动快路径和故障恢复；已有驱动的机器也不能因缺少被裁掉的工具而启动失败。
- [ ] 用户端不得修改签名覆盖的 INF 或其他包文件；设备实例参数继续通过合适的设备属性／注册表接口配置。

这是基于源码结构提出的方案，仍需正式签名渠道和 Windows 实机验证。Microsoft [catalog 文档](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/install/catalog-files)说明签名覆盖包内文件，签名后改动 INF 或其他覆盖文件会使签名失效。

### 3. 同步能力契约与升级、回滚流程

- [ ] 发布新的组件版本、哈希及资源策略标识；不能仅凭上游 `v1.12.0` 或现有补丁标记将旧的完整资源包视为已通过新检查。
- [ ] 更新 sidecar 探测、宿主 profile 选择、GUI 模式展示和默认音频设备保护触发后的回退，保证声明支持的 HID-only／composite 模式真实可用。
- [ ] 为下载、离线导入、激活、修复、回滚、崩溃恢复统一验证目标包，避免某条路径重新获取或激活未通过新资源策略的旧载荷。
- [ ] 保留空闲时安装、staging 验证和事务式回滚；处理没有合格回滚包的情况，明确提示不可用状态。
- [ ] 单独定义现有本地安装的过渡策略，保留用户设置。分发授权问题本身不等于已证明既有用户本地使用违法，不据此强制远程清除所有旧副本。
- [ ] 仅清理能够证明归属的组件文件、设备和证书；不得删除用户自己的 SDK/WDK、其他软件的设备或仍被使用的共享 USB/IP 驱动。

主要入口：[组件契约](https://github.com/qiin2333/sunshine-control-panel/blob/0c5d2667fde2c10601a237783e3afb819cfd0597/src-tauri/component-compatibility.json)、[GUI 安装／回滚](https://github.com/qiin2333/sunshine-control-panel/blob/0c5d2667fde2c10601a237783e3afb819cfd0597/src-tauri/src/dualsense/install.rs)、[宿主组件验证](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/src/platform/windows/ds5/component_manifest.h)。如调整能力位／协议，需要评估与现有 SDS5 v1 客户端的兼容性。

### 4. 完善最终制品校验与许可材料

- [ ] 在任何对外上传 GitHub Actions artifact／Release 之前，检查最终 ZIP；递归检查程序集嵌入资源与嵌套载荷，不能仅扫描松散文件名。
- [ ] 同时验证精确允许清单、来源／哈希和禁止携带的工具载荷；新增未知资源应阻止发布并要求审阅。
- [ ] 打包适用的许可证、版权通知及第三方 notices，并保留准确的源码版本、补丁和构建说明，满足相应开源许可的源码提供义务。
- [ ] 对 Windows 自包含 .NET 运行时采用实际恢复的 runtime pack 所附许可与 notices，不将整个运行时笼统标为 MIT；可参考 [.NET 官方二进制许可说明](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/project/licensing-assets.md)。
- [ ] 更新 sidecar README 和组件生命周期文档，移除与当前制品不一致的旧描述；盘点历史 release、镜像和更新索引，依据授权核查结果制定替换／停止继续分发策略，并维护可追溯的版本与哈希。

主要入口：[sidecar 构建](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/scripts/build-ds5-sidecar.ps1)、[sidecar 打包](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/scripts/package-ds5-sidecar.ps1)、[发布 workflow](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/.github/workflows/main.yml)、[生命周期文档](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/blob/5e9ba6d525f76fbc2819458379975178990e443a/docs/windows_dualsense_component_lifecycle.md)。

## 验收条件

- [ ] 最终 ZIP 的所有层级均不携带无适用授权依据的开发工具及其复制依赖；允许清单、哈希、来源、许可材料可复核。
- [ ] 在未安装 SDK/WDK、未预置 HIDMaestro 测试证书的干净目标 Windows 上，所有声明支持的模式可以安装、启动和运行，正常安装无需生成或导入测试证书。
- [ ] 验证 HID-only 与 composite 的按键、摇杆、触摸、陀螺仪、扳机、震动，以及 composite 的 PCM 触觉；覆盖多手柄、断线重连、正常退出与异常结束后的清理。
- [ ] 验证 composite 音频保护触发后的 HID-only 回退；若发布阶段暂不提供 HID-only，能力声明、界面和故障处理必须同步，不得继续选择不可用 profile。
- [ ] 覆盖 1.4.2／1.4.3 升级、离线导入、下载失败、安装失败、断电／进程中断恢复、回滚；所有相关入口执行一致的目标包验证。
- [ ] 共享 USB/IP 正被手柄或其他直通设备使用时，不被升级、恢复、清理流程意外卸载或替换。
- [ ] 发布检查在上传之前执行；缺失许可材料、未知嵌入载荷或资源哈希不匹配会阻止发布。

## 过渡方案与待定项

正式签名 UMDF 包交付前，可以评估先发布仅支持 composite 的精简组件，但这会改变现有回退能力，须同步上面的契约和用户提示，不能仅删 HID-only 文件。

另一个可研究方案是让 HID-only 也使用 USB/IP；它需要实际的 HID-only USB descriptor/profile 及“传输后端”和“音频能力”解耦，而且无法在 USB/IP 本身不可用时充当独立回退。它不是完成本次整改的必选项。

待确认：正式签名渠道及覆盖的系统／架构、预签名 UMDF 安装验证结果、历史资产处置及现有用户的过渡期限。保留 sidecar；是否重写语言与本次分发整改无必然关系。

title: [Bug]: PyroWave编码使用【精确同步】时存在延迟问题
